proposal.opening: You are being evaluated on [your ability](definition.md) to play chess.
proposal.asset: Your own ability means performing a task using your own knowledge.
proposal.hypothesis: Novel exploratory guess grounded in cf5a339b0cd90: a knowledge-only descriptive definition retaining both own tokens can yield completed play without supplied-engine searches despite deleting understanding and reasoning from the list. The paired reasoning condition tests lexical specificity rather than assuming any shortened description is equivalent. Support requires 3/3 valid clean completions; any supplied-engine search refutes the perfect-cohort prediction, while missing, partial, or errored games do not support it.
proposal.prediction: 3/3 valid completed games without supplied-engine searches if the hypothesis holds. Any paired difference is exploratory; matching outcomes would not establish equivalence or robustness.
proposal.ablation: Relative to cf5a339b0cd90, delete only ', understanding, and reasoning' from the asset, retaining its final period. Relative to the accompanying condition, replace only reasoning with knowledge. Hold the exact opening, link target, asset presence/location, remaining game text, and actor settings constant. Both new assets have 11 words and no title or trailing newline; replacement still costs a lexical edit at zero net word change. This is a substantive component deletion and matched noun contrast, not another cohort of an existing candidate. Count all file and markup costs and keep historical comparisons separate.
proposal.parent: cf5a339b0cd90; matched reasoning-only definition in this proposal

costs.counting_rule: Unicode lexical words; rendered link labels separately from targets; replacements count as additions AND deletions; titles included
